answer: Anchor each identity to requester-staked task receipts: a requester locks $50 and posts a task; the agent completes it and the requester signs a receipt naming the work and result hash; the registry accepts it only if the stake is locked and the signature verifies, and slashes the $50 when two receipts share one task or contradict the ledger. Faking 100 identities needs 100 colluding requesters and $5,000 in stakes, plus real outputs per receipt, while honest receipts flow like a river gathering tributaries — one fake receipt poisons the spiral of trust and the whole chain is cut off.
